[1] Be careful of Sivir’s returning Boomerang Blade (Q)!
[2] Be careful of Jhin’s Dancing Granade (Q) that bounces off of minions, as well as the damage on his final round attack. Use Spell Shield [E] if his final round attack is unavoidable!

[3] In teamfights, position to bait her E on someone else or on a minion, then follow up safely.
[3] If she's misposed then punish her but she'll just run away with her ult if you don't have ccs
[3] Only thing that makes this lane slightly difficult is she gets to dictate early game (lvl1-5) because of her wave clear
